thread:
maya: quick sync — I'm bringing up a mini onboard run for LlamaX-13B (int8-ish quant) with a decoupled speculative path. Goal: measure end-to-end latency win and small quality delta on our eval harness. baseline to compare vs: current hosted 13B fp16

dmitri: what's the exact quant config? PTQ or QAT? and are we running KV cache warmup?

maya: PTQ, adaptive per-tensor, using our q4_0-ish pipeline (we're experimenting with a narrow int8 kernel fallback). KV warmup enabled for 1k tokens. config snippet:
```
model: LlamaX-13B
quant: ptq_per_tensor
kernel_hint: int8_fallback
speculative: decoupled_2stage
warmup_tokens: 1000
```

alice: for eval sets, include: short QA (SQuAD-lite), longform summarization (GovReport-5k), and our regression suite (prompt / hallucination probes). Also check PPL and a hallucination score we compute.

maya: running first pass now. small numbers: local microbench (single card) => baseline fp16: 85ms/token median; quant w/o spec: 66ms/token; quant + decoupled-spec: 40ms/token median (1.6x vs quant, ~2.1x vs fp16).

eva: wow, that's promising. quality tradeoffs? any spikes on longform or safety-sensitive prompts?

maya: preliminary quality delta: SQuAD EM drop ~0.4 points, PPL +0.25, longform rouge-L down ~0.7. hallucination probes: +2.5% false assertions on very long contexts (>3k). Worth noting: most hallucination increases occur when speculative path misses and we fall back mid-token (rare, ~0.8% requests).

dmitri: can you paste the failure stack for mid-token fallback? might be kv-index mismatch on cold cache.

maya: pasted log sample: 
```
[speculator] chosen: draft_variant_v2
[exec] kv_lookup: miss at slot 1024
[exec] fallback -> main_path (cold)
[latency] additional 28ms mid-token
```

alice: that suggests our speculative prefix hash might be drifting in quant kernels. Two options: tighten the speculator confidence threshold (less aggressive) or add a lightweight validation step before streaming tokens. Tradeoff: less speedup.

maya: tried raising confidence threshold from 0.6 -> 0.75: speedup drops from 1.7x to 1.45x vs quant, hallucination delta reduces to +1.0%.

ops-bot: deploy-check: canary target 5% ok if latency < 60ms median and hallucination delta < +1.5%

maya: proposed rollout: canary 5% region A with tightened threshold 0.72, collect 24h of signals (latency, P95, hallucination probe rate). If passes, 25% with same config, then 50% with additional kernel monitoring.

dmitri: add a synthetic stress test for KV churn (random long-context sequences) — if fallback rate >1% under load, abort. Also add a quick offline rerank check (top-5 beam compare) to detect quality regressions that PPL misses.

maya: will run KV churn stress and top-5 rerank within the next 3 hours and post logs. tagging @alice for eval harness tweaks.

alice: will update the harness to include the rerank check and add a small tracer that logs when speculator and main_path diverge. Keep the data anonymized.

maya: next steps: 1) run stress + rerank 2) finalize threshold (likely 0.72) 3) create canary bundle + baseline metrics doc 4) if canary passes, schedule 25% ramp.

eva: thanks — please include perf/cost estimate (tokens/sec and estimated $/million tokens) in the canary doc. want to show ops the unit economics.

maya: will do. leaving logs in the bringup folder and will ping once stress run finishes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
